request.system_prompt: Solve the question. You may briefly explain the calculation in at most five lines. End with exactly one final line: Final Answer: <scalar>. Otherwise retain at least four decimal places for financial amounts. Financial rates use percentage points, for example 7.25 for 7.25%.
